info.title: SuperApp checkUser API
info.description:
Called by the SuperApp platform (server-to-server) to check whether a user exists in your system.

The platform signs every request with HMAC-SHA256 (`TC-Signature`) and encrypts the identity (`openId` / `miniAppId`) in `encryptedData` with AES-256-GCM. See README.md for the full signature and decryption rules.

**Note:** `TC-Signature` depends on the timestamp, path and raw body, so it must be computed for every request. The example values in this document are the README test vectors: they show the format, but the example timestamp is outside the 300-second window, so sending them as-is returns `40102`.

servers.description: Your backend service. Use the console Domain name: host + optional path (basePath).

host.description: Host (and port) of your backend service

basePath.description: Path part of the console Domain name, e.g. /superapp/inner. Empty if the Domain name has no path.

post.description:
Processing order: verify `TC-Signature` → parse body → decrypt `encryptedData` → look up `userId` → persist the `openId + miniAppId ↔ userId` mapping when the user exists.

"User does not exist" is a business result (`returnCode` = `"0"`, `data` = `false`), not a failure. The HTTP status is always 200; check `returnCode`.

parameters.name: TC-Signature
parameters.description:
lowercase_hex( HMAC-SHA256( SIGN_KEY, StringToSign ) ), 64 lowercase hex chars. StringToSign = "TC-SIGN-V1:P2S
" + method + "
" + path + "
" + canonicalQuery + "
" + TC-ApplicationID + "
" + TC-Timestamp + "
" + lowercase_hex(SHA-256(raw body)) + "
". The path is the full request path including basePath.

parameters.name: TC-Timestamp
parameters.description: 13-digit millisecond timestamp. Must be within SIGNATURE_SKEW_SEC (default 300 seconds) of the server time.

parameters.name: TC-ApplicationID
parameters.description: AppID shown in the console. Part of the signature.

parameters.name: TC-TraceID
parameters.description: Trace ID, echoed back as `requestId` and in the `TC-TraceID` response header. A random ID is generated if absent.

requestBody.description: Must be signed as raw bytes: do not re-serialize the JSON before computing the body hash.

200.description: Always HTTP 200; the result is in `returnCode`.

userNotExists.summary: User does not exist (business result, not a failure)

404.description: Path is not `<basePath>/user/checkUser` or method is not POST.

userId.description: Your own user ID (the uid the Super App sets via setAccount).

EncryptedData.description: Encrypted identity. Optional. Plaintext is {"openId":"...","miniAppId":"..."}, encrypted with AES-256-GCM using DATA_ENCRYPT_KEY (32 characters), no AAD.

algorithm.description: Protocol identifier; the cipher is standard AES-256-GCM.

nonce.description: Standard Base64 of the 12-byte random nonce (IV).

returnCode.description: 0 success; 40001 invalid parameter / missing userId; 40101 signature invalid / identity decryption failed; 40102 timestamp expired; 50000 server misconfigured / internal error.

data.description: true: user exists; false: user does not exist; null: request failed (returnCode != 0).
